## Updated requirements — guide v1.4 (8-tool MCP inventory)

**Effective May 2026 (customer confirmation).** Aligns this ticket with `Dynamo Server/Test Guide/dynamo-mcp-testing-guide_v1.4.md` and `Dynamo Server/Test Result/dynamo_mcp_testing_stories_v1.2.md`. **Does not replace** earlier text in this description.

**8-tool customer-confirmed surface**

| # | Tool | Availability (May 2026) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `analyze_notes` | Available |
| 2 | `get_activity` | Available |
| 3 | `get_documents` | Available |
| 4 | `get_fund_description` | Available |
| 5 | `get_funds` | Available |
| 6 | `get_notes` | Available |
| 7 | `llm_text_analysis` | Available |
| 8 | `read_data` | **Planned** — add to regression when registered in the client |

**Out of scope for v1.4:** `describe_table`, `get_rating_details`, `get_rating_summary`, `list_table`, `search_aloha_funds`.

**section 1.4 (guide v1.4):** only `read_data` is HIGH risk. Mark `read_data` scenarios **S (skipped)** until the tool is registered.

**Ticket-specific expectations (stories v1.2):**
In scope: `llm_text_analysis` (section 5.7).
